slides.texte_overlay:
Small luxuries every man
should learn to enjoy
A long hot shower after a cold day. No rushing, no phone, just warm water and quiet. Ten minutes of warmth after a long day is a simple pleasure worth slowing down for.
A good book on a rainy afternoon. Blanket, tea, the sound of rain on the window. Few things feel as rich as losing yourself in a story with nowhere to be.
Fresh bread from a real bakery. Warm, crusty, still smelling of the oven. It costs almost nothing and turns an ordinary breakfast into a small celebration.
Learning something beautiful every day. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and discovering a painting or a story with my coffee is my favourite luxury.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Discovering a painting or a story with my coffee is my favourite luxury.

slides.texte_overlay: A Sunday morning swim. An almost empty pool, cool water, slow laps. You come out feeling light, clear-headed and ready for whatever the week brings you.
Watching the sunset without filming it. Sit somewhere with a view and just look. Enjoying a moment fully, without a screen, has become a real luxury.
A handwritten letter in your mailbox. Write one to a friend, and soon one will come back. Opening a real letter feels better than a hundred messages.
